run_deep_cfr_solver: run Deep CFR solver on a game with configurable iterations, traversals, and neural network hyperparameters
create_DeepCFRSolver: create a DeepCFRSolver instance with game, network layers, batch sizes, learning rate, and memory capacity
test_nash_conv: test exploitability of a trained policy by computing Nash convexity against the average policy
summarize_policy_values: summarize expected game values for each player under the computed average policy
build_tabular_policy: build a tabular policy from a callable action-probabilities function for use with OpenSpiel utilities
